            nn.Dropout(0.5),

            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, meta_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze() * 100

# Image feature extraction with ResNet50
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = models.resnet50(pretrained=True)
model = torch.nn.Sequential(*(list(model.children())[:-1])).to(device).eval()

preprocess = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


def extract_features(df, folder):
    features = []
    for img_id in df["Id"]:
        img = Image.open(f"./input/{folder}/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        img_tensor = preprocess(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            feat = model(img_tensor).squeeze().cpu().numpy()
        features.append(feat)
    return np.array(features)


# Process all images

test_feats = extract_features(test_df, "test").reshape(len(test_df), -1)

}

lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val)

# Evaluate

print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")

# Generate submission
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)
pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df["Id"], "Pawpularity": test_pred}).to_csv(

# Configuration
BATCH_SIZE = 32
IMG_SIZE = 384
LR = 1e-4
EPOCHS = 15
EMBED_DIM = 128

test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
features = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",

]

# Stratified split by Pawpularity bins
bins = np.linspace(0, 100, 11)
train_df["bin"] = pd.cut(train_df["Pawpularity"], bins=bins, labels=False)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.25, stratify=train_df["bin"], random_state=42
)
train_df = train_df.drop("bin", axis=1)


# Dataset class
class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row.Id + ".jpg")
        image = T.functional.pil_to_tensor(
            T.functional.resize(T.io.read_image(img_path), IMG_SIZE)
        )

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)

        meta = torch.FloatTensor(row[features].values.astype(float))
        if self.is_test:
            return image, meta
        return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([row.Pawpularity / 100])

train_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),

            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feats = self.vit(img)
        meta_feats = self.meta_net(meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feats, meta_feats], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze()

val_ds = PetDataset(train_df.loc[val_idx], "./input/train/", val_transforms)

    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):

        if self.transform:

        )

        )

            nn.Linear(12, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.2), nn.Linear(256, 512)
        )
        self.attention = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 256), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(256, 512), nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1024, 512), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3), nn.Linear(512, 1)
        )

        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        meta_feat = self.meta(x_meta)
        attn_weights = self.attention(meta_feat)
        img_attn = img_feat * attn_weights
        combined = torch.cat([img_attn, meta_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)

class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, img_dim)
        self.meta_proj = nn.Linear(meta_dim, img_dim)
        self.attention = MultiheadAttention(img_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(img_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        # Project features to same dimension
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_feat).unsqueeze(1)

        # Cross-attention: meta as query, image as key/value
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(meta_proj, img_proj, img_proj)
        return self.norm(attn_out.squeeze(1) + meta_feat)


class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_encoder = models.efficientnet_b4(weights="DEFAULT")
        self.img_encoder.classifier = nn.Identity()

            nn.Linear(12, 512),

            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
        )

        self.fusion = CrossAttentionFusion(1792, 512)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)  # [batch, 1792]
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)  # [batch, 512]

        # Cross-attention fusion
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, fused], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze() * 100

        meta_feat = self.meta(x_meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, meta_feat], dim=1)

class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, meta_dim)
        self.meta_proj = nn.Linear(meta_dim, meta_dim)
        self.attention = MultiheadAttention(meta_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(meta_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(meta_proj, img_proj, img_proj)
        return self.norm(attn_out.squeeze(1) + meta_feat)

        )

        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, fused], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze() * 100

LR = 1e-4
EPOCHS = 15
EMBED_DIM = 128

    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",

    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]

# Stratified split
bins = np.linspace(0, 100, 11)
train_df["bin"] = pd.cut(train_df["Pawpularity"], bins=bins, labels=False)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.25, stratify=train_df["bin"], random_state=42
)
train_df = train_df.drop("bin", axis=1)


# Dataset class
class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row.Id + ".jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = T.functional.resize(image, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
        image = T.functional.pil_to_tensor(image)

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)

        meta = torch.FloatTensor(row[features].values.astype(float))
        if self.is_test:
            return image, meta
        return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([row.Pawpularity / 100])


# Augmentations
train_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomAffine(degrees=15, translate=(0.1, 0.1), scale=(0.9, 1.1)),
        T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2),
        T.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


# Model architecture
class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = create_model(
            "convnext_base_384_in22ft1k", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.meta_net = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(12, 64), nn.SiLU(), nn.Dropout(0.3))
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(self.cnn.num_features + 64, EMBED_DIM),
            nn.LayerNorm(EMBED_DIM),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feats = self.cnn(img)
        meta_feats = self.meta_net(meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feats, meta_feats], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze()


# Initialize model
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = PawpularityModel().to(device)
opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, EPOCHS)

# DataLoaders
train_ds = PetDataset(train_df.loc[train_idx], "./input/train/", train_transforms)
val_ds = PetDataset(train_df.loc[val_idx], "./input/train/", val_transforms)
test_ds = PetDataset(test_df, "./input/test/", val_transforms, is_test=True)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

# Training loop
best_val = float("inf")
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for imgs, metas, targets in train_loader:
        imgs, metas, targets = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device), targets.to(device)
        opt.zero_grad()
        preds = model(imgs, metas)
        loss = nn.MSELoss()(preds, targets)
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()

    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, metas, targets in val_loader:
            imgs, metas, targets = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device), targets.to(device)
            preds = model(imgs, metas)
            val_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
            val_targets.extend(targets.cpu().numpy())

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val RMSE {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_val:
        best_val = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth")

    scheduler.step()

print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_val:.4f}")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

with torch.no_grad():

class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, meta_dim)
        self.meta_proj = nn.Linear(meta_dim, meta_dim)
        self.attention = MultiheadAttention(meta_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(meta_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(meta_proj, img_proj, img_proj)
        return self.norm(attn_out.squeeze(1) + meta_feat)

            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
        )
        self.fusion = CrossAttentionFusion(1792, 512)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, fused], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze() * 100

from torch import nn
import torchvision.transforms as T
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from timm import create_model
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import os
from PIL import Image

# Configuration
BATCH_SIZE = 32
IMG_SIZE = 384
LR = 1e-4
EPOCHS = 15
CNN_FEATURES = 1024  # ConvNext base features
META_FEATURES = 64
EMBED_DIM = 256

# Data preparation
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
features = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]

# Stratified split
bins = np.linspace(0, 100, 11)
train_df["bin"] = pd.cut(train_df["Pawpularity"], bins=bins, labels=False)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.25, stratify=train_df["bin"], random_state=42
)
train_df = train_df.drop("bin", axis=1)


class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row.Id + ".jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = T.functional.resize(image, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
        image = T.functional.pil_to_tensor(image)

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)

        meta = torch.FloatTensor(row[features].values.astype(float))
        if self.is_test:
            return image, meta
        return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([row.Pawpularity / 100])


# Augmentations
train_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomAffine(degrees=15, translate=(0.1, 0.1), scale=(0.9, 1.1)),
        T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2),
        T.RandomErasing(p=0.3, scale=(0.02, 0.2), value="random"),
        T.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = create_model(
            "convnext_base_384_in22ft1k", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )
        self.meta_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(12, 128),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, META_FEATURES),
            nn.SiLU(),
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(CNN_FEATURES + META_FEATURES, EMBED_DIM),
            nn.LayerNorm(EMBED_DIM),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM, EMBED_DIM // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(EMBED_DIM // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM // 2, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feats = self.cnn(img)
        meta_feats = self.meta_net(meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feats, meta_feats], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze()


# Initialize model
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = PawpularityModel().to(device)
opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, EPOCHS)

# DataLoaders
train_ds = PetDataset(train_df.loc[train_idx], "./input/train/", train_transforms)
val_ds = PetDataset(train_df.loc[val_idx], "./input/train/", val_transforms)
test_ds = PetDataset(test_df, "./input/test/", val_transforms, is_test=True)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)

# Training loop
best_val = float("inf")
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for imgs, metas, targets in train_loader:
        imgs, metas, targets = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device), targets.to(device)
        opt.zero_grad()
        preds = model(imgs, metas)
        loss = nn.SmoothL1Loss()(preds, targets)
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()

    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, metas, targets in val_loader:
            imgs, metas, targets = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device), targets.to(device)
            preds = model(imgs, metas)
            val_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
            val_targets.extend(targets.cpu().numpy())

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(val_targets, val_preds)) * 100
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val RMSE {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_val:
        best_val = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth")

    scheduler.step()

print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_val:.4f}")

# Load best model and predict
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for imgs, metas in test_loader:
        imgs, metas = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device)
        augmented_imgs = torch.cat([imgs, T.functional.hflip(imgs)], dim=0)
        augmented_metas = torch.cat([metas, metas], dim=0)
        preds = model(augmented_imgs, augmented_metas)
        preds = preds.view(2, -1).mean(dim=0)
        test_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy() * 100)

# Generate submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_df.Id, "Pawpularity": np.clip(test_preds, 1, 100)}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
import pandas as pd

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from torchvision import transforms, models
from PIL import Image
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
meta_cols = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",

# Data preparation
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")

train_data, val_data = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)


class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, self.df.iloc[idx]["Id"] + ".jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        metadata = self.df.iloc[idx][meta_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)
        return (
            (image, metadata)
            if self.is_test
            else (image, metadata, self.df.iloc[idx]["Pawpularity"] / 100.0)
        )


# Image transforms
input_size = 384
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(input_size),
        transforms.RandomResizedCrop(input_size, scale=(0.6, 1.0)),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandAugment(num_ops=3, magnitude=9),

        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(input_size),
        transforms.CenterCrop(input_size),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

test_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(input_size + 32),
        transforms.FiveCrop(input_size),
        transforms.Lambda(
            lambda crops: [transforms.ToTensor()(crop) for crop in crops]
        ),
        transforms.Lambda(
            lambda crops: torch.stack(
                [
                    transforms.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225])(
                        crop
                    )
                    for crop in crops
                ]
            )
        ),
    ]
)

# Data loaders
batch_size = 32
train_loader = DataLoader(
    PetDataset(train_data, "./input/train", train_transform),

    shuffle=True,
    num_workers=8,
    pin_memory=True,
    drop_last=True,
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    PetDataset(val_data, "./input/train", val_transform),
    batch_size=batch_size * 2,
    num_workers=8,
    pin_memory=True,
)


class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = models.convnext_large(pretrained=True)
        self.cnn.classifier = nn.Sequential(
            nn.LayerNorm([1536], eps=1e-6),
            nn.Flatten(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(1536, 512),
        )
        self.meta = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(12, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512 + 256, 512),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, x_img, x_meta):
        img_feat = self.cnn(x_img)
        meta_feat = self.meta(x_meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, meta_feat], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined)


model = PawpularityModel().to(device)
scaler = GradScaler()
optimizer = optim.AdamW(
    [
        {"params": model.cnn.parameters(), "lr": 5e-6},
        {
            "params": list(model.meta.parameters()) + list(model.head.parameters()),
            "lr": 1e-3,
        },
    ],
    weight_decay=1e-4,
)

scheduler = optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
    optimizer,
    max_lr=[5e-6, 1e-3],
    steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader),
    epochs=20,
    pct_start=0.2,
)
criterion = nn.MSELoss()

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(20):
    model.train()
    for images, metadata, targets in train_loader:
        images = images.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        metadata = metadata.to(device, non_blocking=True)
        targets = targets.float().unsqueeze(1).to(device, non_blocking=True)

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        with autocast():
            outputs = model(images, metadata)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets)
        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()
        scheduler.step()

    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_true = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, metadata, targets in val_loader:
            images = images.to(device)
            metadata = metadata.to(device)
            outputs = model(images, metadata)
            val_preds.extend(outputs.cpu().numpy().flatten() * 100)
            val_true.extend(targets.cpu().numpy().flatten() * 100)

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((np.array(val_preds) - np.array(val_true)) ** 2))
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth")

# Generate submission with TTA
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

test_ds = PetDataset(test_df, "./input/test", transform=test_transform, is_test=True)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, batch_size=32, num_workers=8, shuffle=False)

final_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for images, metadata in test_loader:
        B, N_crops, C, H, W = images.shape
        images = images.view(B * N_crops, C, H, W).to(device)
        metadata = metadata.repeat_interleave(N_crops, dim=0).to(device)
        outputs = model(images, metadata)
        outputs = outputs.view(B, N_crops).mean(dim=1)
        final_preds.extend(outputs.cpu().numpy().flatten() * 100)

submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_df["Id"], "Pawpularity": np.clip(final_preds, 0, 100)}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(

)


class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_target = "Pawpularity" in df.columns

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["Id"] + ".jpg")

        meta = row[meta_features].values.astype("float32")
        if self.has_target:
            target = row["Pawpularity"] / 100
            return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([target])
        return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([0.0])


train_ds = PetDataset(train_df, "input/train", train_transform)

class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, meta_dim)
        self.meta_proj = nn.Linear(meta_dim, meta_dim)
        self.attention = MultiheadAttention(meta_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(meta_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(meta_proj, img_proj, img_proj)
        return self.norm(attn_out.squeeze(1) + meta_feat)


class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_encoder = models.efficientnet_b4(weights="DEFAULT")
        self.img_encoder.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.meta_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(12, 512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
        )
        self.fusion = CrossAttentionFusion(1792, 512)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1792 + 512, 1024),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(1024, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, fused], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze() * 100


model = PawpularityModel().to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
    [
        {"params": model.img_encoder.parameters(), "lr": 2e-5},
        {"params": model.meta_encoder.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
        {"params": model.fusion.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
        {"params": model.head.parameters(), "lr": 1e-4},
    ],
    weight_decay=1e-5,
)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts(optimizer, T_0=5)
criterion = nn.HuberLoss()

best_rmse = float("inf")
for epoch in range(30):

        optimizer.zero_grad()

        loss = criterion(outputs, targets.squeeze())
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

    model.eval()
    val_loss = 0
    with torch.no_grad():
        for images, metas, targets in val_loader:
            images, metas, targets = (
                images.to(device),
                metas.to(device),
                targets.to(device),
            )
            outputs = model(images, metas)
            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets.squeeze()).item() * len(images)
    val_rmse = np.sqrt(val_loss / len(val_ds))
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val RMSE {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

tta_transforms = [
    transforms.Compose([transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.0)]),
    transforms.Compose([transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=1.0)]),

            outputs = model(tta_images, metas.to(device))
            batch_preds.append(outputs.cpu().numpy())
        avg_preds = np.mean(batch_preds, axis=0)
        preds.extend(avg_preds)

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Image feature extraction with EfficientNet-B7
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = models.efficientnet_b7(pretrained=True)
model = (
    torch.nn.Sequential(
        model.features, torch.nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(1), torch.nn.Flatten()
    )
    .to(device)

)

preprocess = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((600, 600)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


def extract_features(df, folder):
    features = []
    for img_id in df["Id"]:
        img = Image.open(f"./input/{folder}/{img_id}.jpg").convert("RGB")
        img_tensor = preprocess(img).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
        with torch.no_grad():
            feat = model(img_tensor).cpu().numpy()
        features.append(feat)
    return np.vstack(features)

class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, meta_dim)
        self.meta_proj = nn.Linear(meta_dim, meta_dim)
        self.attention = MultiheadAttention(meta_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(meta_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(meta_proj, img_proj, img_proj)
        return self.norm(attn_out.squeeze(1) + meta_feat)

        )
        self.fusion = CrossAttentionFusion(2048, 512)

            nn.LayerNorm(1024),
            nn.Dropout(0.4),
            nn.Linear(1024, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, fused], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze() * 100

import torch
from torch import nn

from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader

# Configuration
BATCH_SIZE = 32
IMG_SIZE = 384
LR = 1e-4
EPOCHS = 30
META_FEATURES = 64
EMBED_DIM = 256
PATIENCE = 5
MIXUP_ALPHA = 0.4  # Controls MixUp strength

# Data preparation
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
features = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]

# Stratified split
bins = np.linspace(0, 100, 11)
train_df["bin"] = pd.cut(train_df["Pawpularity"], bins=bins, labels=False)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.25, stratify=train_df["bin"], random_state=42
)
train_df = train_df.drop("bin", axis=1)


class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None, is_test=False):
        self.df = df
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.is_test = is_test

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row.Id + ".jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        image = T.functional.resize(image, (IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE))
        image = T.functional.pil_to_tensor(image)

        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)

        meta = torch.FloatTensor(row[features].values.astype(float))
        if self.is_test:
            return image, meta
        return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([row.Pawpularity / 100])


# Augmentations
train_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5),
        T.RandomAffine(degrees=15, translate=(0.1, 0.1), scale=(0.9, 1.1)),
        T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.2, contrast=0.2, saturation=0.2),
        T.RandomErasing(p=0.3, scale=(0.02, 0.2), value="random"),
        T.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transforms = T.Compose(
    [
        T.ConvertImageDtype(torch.float32),
        T.Normalize([0.485, 0.456, 0.406], [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = create_model(
            "convnext_base_384_in22ft1k", pretrained=True, num_classes=0
        )

        with torch.no_grad():
            dummy_input = torch.randn(1, 3, IMG_SIZE, IMG_SIZE)
            cnn_features = self.cnn(dummy_input).shape[1]

        self.meta_net = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(12, 128),
            nn.SiLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, META_FEATURES),
            nn.SiLU(),
        )
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(cnn_features + META_FEATURES, EMBED_DIM),
            nn.LayerNorm(EMBED_DIM),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM, EMBED_DIM // 2),
            nn.LayerNorm(EMBED_DIM // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(EMBED_DIM // 2, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feats = self.cnn(img)
        meta_feats = self.meta_net(meta)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feats, meta_feats], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze()


device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
model = PawpularityModel().to(device)

# Differential learning rates
param_groups = [
    {"params": model.cnn.parameters(), "lr": LR / 10},
    {"params": model.meta_net.parameters(), "lr": LR},
    {"params": model.head.parameters(), "lr": LR},
]
opt = torch.optim.AdamW(param_groups, weight_decay=1e-4)
scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.CosineAnnealingLR(opt, EPOCHS)

# DataLoaders

)

test_loader = DataLoader(test_ds, BATCH_SIZE * 2, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True)


def mixup_data(x, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_y = lam * y + (1 - lam) * y[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_y, lam, index


def mixup_criterion(pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return nn.SmoothL1Loss()(pred, y_a) * lam + nn.SmoothL1Loss()(pred, y_b) * (1 - lam)


# Training loop with MixUp
best_val = float("inf")
epochs_without_improve = 0
for epoch in range(EPOCHS):
    model.train()
    for imgs, metas, targets in train_loader:
        imgs, metas, targets = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device), targets.to(device)

        # Apply MixUp to images and targets
        mixed_imgs, mixed_targets, lam, index = mixup_data(imgs, targets, MIXUP_ALPHA)
        mixed_metas = lam * metas + (1 - lam) * metas[index]

        opt.zero_grad()
        preds = model(mixed_imgs, mixed_metas)
        loss = mixup_criterion(preds, targets, targets[index], lam)
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        opt.step()

    model.eval()
    val_preds, val_targets = [], []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, metas, targets in val_loader:
            imgs, metas, targets = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device), targets.to(device)
            preds = model(imgs, metas)
            val_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())
            val_targets.extend(targets.cpu().numpy())

    val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(val_targets, val_preds)) * 100
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val RMSE {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_val:
        best_val = val_rmse
        epochs_without_improve = 0
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "./working/best_model.pth")
    else:
        epochs_without_improve += 1
        if epochs_without_improve >= PATIENCE:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
            break

    scheduler.step()

print(f"Best Validation RMSE: {best_val:.4f}")

# Load best model and predict
model.load_state_dict(torch.load("./working/best_model.pth"))
model.eval()

# TTA predictions
test_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for imgs, metas in test_loader:
        imgs, metas = imgs.to(device), metas.to(device)

        # Original
        preds = model(imgs, metas)
        # Horizontal flip
        flipped_imgs = torch.flip(imgs, [3])
        preds_flipped = model(flipped_imgs, metas)
        avg_preds = (preds + preds_flipped) / 2
        test_preds.extend(avg_preds.cpu().numpy() * 100)

# Generate submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Id": test_df.Id, "Pawpularity": np.clip(test_preds, 1, 100)}
)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

def mixup_data(x, y, alpha=1.0):
    if alpha > 0:
        lam = np.random.beta(alpha, alpha)
    else:
        lam = 1

    batch_size = x.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)

    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_y = lam * y + (1 - lam) * y[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_y, lam, index


def mixup_criterion(pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return nn.SmoothL1Loss()(pred, y_a) * lam + nn.SmoothL1Loss()(pred, y_b) * (1 - lam)

        mixed_metas = lam * metas + (1 - lam) * metas[index]

        opt.zero_grad()
        preds = model(mixed_imgs, mixed_metas)
        loss = mixup_criterion(preds, targets, targets[index], lam)
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)

    val_preds, val_targets = [], []

    else:
        epochs_without_improve += 1
        if epochs_without_improve >= PATIENCE:

    if alpha > 0:

    else:
        lam = 1
    batch_size = x.size()[0]
    index = torch.randperm(batch_size).to(x.device)
    mixed_x = lam * x + (1 - lam) * x[index]
    mixed_y = lam * y + (1 - lam) * y[index]
    return mixed_x, mixed_y, lam, index


def mixup_criterion(pred, y_a, y_b, lam):
    return nn.SmoothL1Loss()(pred, y_a) * lam + nn.SmoothL1Loss()(pred, y_b) * (1 - lam)

class CrossAttentionFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.img_proj = nn.Linear(img_dim, meta_dim)
        self.meta_proj = nn.Linear(meta_dim, meta_dim)
        self.attention = MultiheadAttention(meta_dim, num_heads=8, batch_first=True)
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(meta_dim)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        img_proj = self.img_proj(img_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        meta_proj = self.meta_proj(meta_feat).unsqueeze(1)
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(meta_proj, img_proj, img_proj)
        return self.norm(attn_out.squeeze(1) + meta_feat)

            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        combined = torch.cat([img_feat, fused], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze()

            nn.Linear(CNN_FEATURES + META_FEATURES, EMBED_DIM),
            nn.LayerNorm(EMBED_DIM),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(DROPOUT_RATE),

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from PIL import Image
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torchvision.transforms as transforms
from torchvision import models

# Config
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
batch_size = 32
num_workers = 4
img_size = 300

# Data loading
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
meta_features = [
    "Subject Focus",
    "Eyes",
    "Face",
    "Near",
    "Action",
    "Accessory",
    "Group",
    "Collage",
    "Human",
    "Occlusion",
    "Info",
    "Blur",
]

# Split validation
train_df, val_df = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)

# Image transforms (same as before)
train_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((img_size + 32, img_size + 32)),
        transforms.RandomResizedCrop(img_size, scale=(0.7, 1.0)),
        transforms.RandomHorizontalFlip(),
        transforms.RandomAffine(15, translate=(0.15, 0.15)),
        transforms.ColorJitter(brightness=0.3, contrast=0.3, saturation=0.3, hue=0.1),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

val_transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((img_size, img_size)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)


# Dataset class (unchanged)
class PetDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, df, img_dir, transform=None):
        self.df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
        self.img_dir = img_dir
        self.transform = transform
        self.has_target = "Pawpularity" in df.columns

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        row = self.df.iloc[idx]
        img_path = os.path.join(self.img_dir, row["Id"] + ".jpg")
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)
        meta = row[meta_features].values.astype("float32")
        if self.has_target:
            target = row["Pawpularity"] / 100
            return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([target])
        return image, meta, torch.FloatTensor([0.0])


# Data loaders
train_ds = PetDataset(train_df, "input/train", train_transform)
val_ds = PetDataset(val_df, "input/train", val_transform)
test_ds = PetDataset(test_df, "input/test", val_transform)

train_loader = DataLoader(
    train_ds, batch_size, True, num_workers=num_workers, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(
    val_ds, batch_size * 2, num_workers=num_workers, pin_memory=True
)
test_loader = DataLoader(
    test_ds, batch_size * 2, num_workers=num_workers, pin_memory=True
)


# Bilinear Fusion Model
class BilinearFusion(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, img_dim, meta_dim, out_dim, rank=256):
        super().__init__()
        self.U = nn.Linear(img_dim, rank, bias=False)
        self.V = nn.Linear(meta_dim, rank, bias=False)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(rank, out_dim)
        self.bn = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.3)

    def forward(self, img_feat, meta_feat):
        U = self.U(img_feat)
        V = self.V(meta_feat)
        fused = U * V  # Element-wise product
        fused = self.proj(fused)
        return self.dropout(self.bn(fused))


class PawpularityModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Image encoder
        self.img_encoder = models.efficientnet_b3(weights="DEFAULT")
        self.img_encoder.classifier = nn.Identity()

        # Metadata encoder
        self.meta_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(12, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
            nn.Linear(128, 64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
            nn.Dropout(0.3),
        )

        # Bilinear fusion
        self.fusion = BilinearFusion(1536, 64, 512)

        # Prediction head
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(512, 512),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.BatchNorm1d(512),
            nn.Dropout(0.5),
            nn.Linear(512, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def forward(self, img, meta):
        img_feat = self.img_encoder(img)
        meta_feat = self.meta_encoder(meta)
        fused = self.fusion(img_feat, meta_feat)
        return self.head(fused).squeeze() * 100


# Training setup
model = PawpularityModel().to(device)
optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)

            val_loss += criterion(outputs, targets.squeeze()).item() * len(images)

    scheduler.step(val_rmse)
    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}: Val RMSE {val_rmse:.4f}")

    if val_rmse < best_rmse:
        best_rmse = val_rmse
        torch.save(model.state_dict(), "best_model.pth")
